title: Affine subspace PCPP description
statement: Let $n$ be positive, let $V$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $a\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The affine subspace $a+V$ of the Boolean cube has a PCPP description with proof length $2^n$, query count three, and rejection rate $1/8$. The described system satisfies perfect completeness and rejects every proof for an input at relative Hamming distance greater than $\varepsilon$ from the property with probability greater than $(1/8)\varepsilon$, for every $\varepsilon\in[0,1]$.
